samira: Quick heads-upI'm updating the Hello quickstart to prefer OIDC for Private/Dedicated and adding a small local auth-proxy compose for dev. Need two quick things: 1) copycheck on SDK snippets, 2) a tiny CI smoke job to validate the compose override.

owen: Sounds good. Will we still show the API_KEY path?

samira: Yes keeping a legacy API_KEY accordion in the doc for fallback. New default shows REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE and an SDK v10 snippet.

pat: Can you paste the actual env+snippet so I can verify copy/paste?

samira: Sure, short example to include: 

```
# .env (recommended for private)
REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE=oidc
REDWOOD_OIDC_ISSUER=https://idp.example.com
OIDC_CLIENT_ID=rr-qs-local
# dev only
REDWOOD_LOCAL_AUTH_PROXY=true
```

# Python SDK v10 (example)
from redwood import Client
c = Client(auth_mode="oidc")
print(c.generate("hi").text)
```

samira: I'll add a docker-compose.override.yml with a `local-auth-proxy` service that exchanges codes for session tokens so devs don't need a live IdP during the tutorial. Security callout: "dev-only, never run in prod".

owen: For CI, I'll add `ci/docs_quickstart_oidc_smoke.sh` that: 1) starts compose, 2) seeds test creds via prow secret helper, 3) runs `tests/quickstart_oidc_smoke.py`. Use the docs pipeline label.

pat: One small ask: include a short migration checklist for Dedicated customers in the doc: create OIDC client, add redirect URIs, move secret to KMS, update REDWOOD_AUTH_MODE, run smoke tests, monitor rotation. That will cut down support tickets.

samira: Good ideaI'll add that and a one-liner for local dev: `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f compose.dev.yml up --build && ./scripts/dev/seed_oidc_test_secrets.sh && ./scripts/dev/run_quickstart_smoke.sh`.

ci-bot: PR opened by samira: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5201 - quickstart: prefer OIDC + local-auth-proxy + CI smoke

owen: Quick nit: don't call the proxy a "mini-IdP" in the docs. Use "local auth proxy (dev-only)" and make the security note prominent. Also link to /private-deploy/auth for Private docs.

samira: Will fix wording and add the link. Targeting merge tomorrow 09:00 PT after CI green. :rocket:
